customers_say: Customers find the water purifier reliable, budget-friendly, and easy to use, with good water quality and taste. They appreciate the free installation process and consider it good value for money. The service receives mixed feedback, with some praising the prompt service while others find the customer care team disappointing.

reviews.author: md asim
reviews.title: Great Product and Excellent Installation Service!
reviews.body: I recently purchased the Aquaguard Delight Aquasaver 2X Water Purifier, and I’m happy with the product. The purifier works well, and the installation service was quick, smooth, and hassle-free. The overall experience was very good, from purchase to installation. I would definitely recommend Aquaguard to anyone looking for a reliable water purifier. Great product and excellent service!

reviews.author: Rajkumar Yaduwanshi
reviews.title: Good Product and Satisfactory Performance
reviews.body: The RO water purifier is working well and provides clean, good-tasting water. The design is nice, and it is easy to use. Overall, I am satisfied with the product and would recommend it to others.

reviews.author: sangram keshari dash
reviews.title: Very dissatisfied
reviews.body: I purchased this Aquaguard water purifier from Amazon expecting clean and pure drinking water. However, after installation, the technician informed me that I needed to install an additional iron filter, which would cost ₹2,100 extra. If I am purchasing a water purifier, I expect to know about such additional requirements and costs beforehand, not after the product has been delivered and installed. Why should I have to pay extra just to make the purifier suitable for my water? This experience has been extremely disappointing. reviews.author: Mukul sinha
reviews.title: A good buy with average build quality
reviews.body: It’s working fine after installing a TDS controller, as the company doesn’t provide one. Although my tap water has a TDS of around 120 ppm, I purchased an RO purifier due to the presence of heavy metals. The RO reduced the TDS to 10–15 ppm, so a TDS controller was needed. However, since it bypasses some untreated water, the RO’s purpose is somewhat compromised, as some heavy metals may remain in the final water. Whole body is of plastic having build quality not as expected.Apperance is good, installation service was fast but after sale service is slow.Overall,a good buy,but let's see how it go

reviews.author: Helloworld
reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.body: The water purifier itself seems good, but I had a disappointing experience with the installation technician. The technician showed me a TDS meter reading of 900+ ppm and recommended that I purchase an additional pre-filter. I declined because a pre-filter is primarily meant to remove suspended particles/impurities and does not reduce TDS. What concerned me more was that the technician did not check the TDS of the purified water after installation. He also told me that the filter warranty was only 1 year.
